assumptions: An exact proposed motion depends on a situated-capacity condition that remains unestablished.
An attributable local HOLD preserves that question at the smallest truthful scope under its valid basis.
The HOLD materially constrains another relation.
scenario.proposed_claim: Hold only the dependent motion while preserving the unresolved capacity condition.
expected_reading: HOLD does not decide the held question or turn missing support into falsehood or general incapacity.
Attribution, scope, review, correction, and the possibility of ending remain recoverable.
Unrelated supported motion is not frozen merely by this uncertainty; time alone does not make the HOLD final.
forbidden_inferences: HOLD is a final negative decision.
